Body.Content:
Microsoft Purview is improving auto-labeling capabilities to help organizations manage and validate labeling policies at enterprise scale. These enhancements expand support for larger SharePoint scopes, improve policy management flexibility, and provide richer visibility into auto-labeling activity.

GA date: October CY2026

Preview date: September CY2026
